output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to a ridiculously high value.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in these two assert statements: 'assert(balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to] == previousBalances);'
The 'buy' function has an integer overflow that allows the buy price to be set to zero, making it unusable by users.
The 'selfdestructs' function is intended to delete the contract, but it is written with a typo 'selfdestruct' instead of 'delete'. This typo makes it impossible to deploy the smart contract.
The 'getEth' function allows anyone to transfer num wei from the contract to their account, causing potential financial loss to the users.
